description: This file implements a client for interacting with a documentation-related AI process, including process management, prompt handling, event reading, and response parsing.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: Controls the external AI process, manages communication channels, and handles synchronization for client requests and responses.

classes.name: piEvent
classes.description: Represents an event emitted by the AI process, with a type and raw JSON message.

classes.name: agentEndPayload
classes.description: Struct for parsing the agent's end message, including message history and type.

classes.name: rpcResponse
classes.description: Represents an RPC response message with ID, success status, and error information.

classes.name: agentMessage
classes.description: Represents a message from or to the agent, including role, content, and error indicators.

classes.name: contentBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of content with type and text, used when parsing message content.

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the external process, returning an instance of docsPiClient.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the process and waits for a response or error.

methods.name: Stderr
methods.description: Returns the captured standard error output from the process.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the process and cleans up resources.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Continuously reads stderr from the process and buffers it.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads stdout, parses JSON messages, and emits events.

methods.name: extractTranslationResult
methods.description: Extracts text result from the agent's end message, handling errors.

methods.name: extractContentText
methods.description: Parses content JSON to extract plain text.

methods.name: decodeRpcResponse
methods.description: Parses raw JSON into an rpcResponse struct.

methods.name: getDocsPiAgentDir
methods.description: Returns the directory for agent data, creating it if necessary.
